scope: Derived directly from six valid raw actual Lighthouse13.5 JSON reports. Observed insight phase durations and dependency-tree timings must not be summed to infer numeric Lantern-simulated LCP. Audit main-thread durations are trace CPU timing adjusted per Lighthouse implementation, documented separately. No raw reports altered.

implementationNotes.lcpInsight: Observed unthrottled trace timings. Numeric LCP metric is Lantern simulation, so insight phases do not sum to simulated metric.
implementationNotes.mainthreadAudit: Lighthouse mainthread-work-breakdown and bootup-time multiply observed CPU category durations by config cpuSlowdownMultiplier (4 here). These are scaled trace totals, not the actual complete Lantern critical-path decomposition.
implementationNotes.longTaskAudit: long-tasks uses simulated node start/duration when throttlingMethod=simulate. Raw item values retained.
implementationNotes.networkDependencyTree: Observed network tree timings, separate from Lantern simulated network path.
